f.title: May request a change of EU reference date or frequency, in writing with justification
f.statement: The MAH of a product whose PSUR frequency and dates have been harmonised may ask the CHMP or Coordination Group to change the EU reference date or frequency for public health reasons, to avoid duplicate assessments or for international harmonisation. Requests must be in writing and duly justified. If the request is granted, the MAH must then submit a variation application to the Danish Medicines Agency.

f.title: Veterinary: submit PSURs on request and at fixed data lock points
f.statement: The MAH of a veterinary medicinal product shall submit the records referred to in § 5 to the Danish Medicines Agency as PSURs immediately on request and at the following data lock points: every six months after authorisation in Denmark until marketing starts; every six months for the first two years after first marketing; once a year for the following two years; every three years thereafter; and on application for renewal of the MA.

f.statement: The MAH of a veterinary product may synchronise PSUR submission in Denmark with other countries and may use the anniversary of authorisation in another country to calculate data lock points, provided the time limits in stk. 1 are not extended. The MAH must notify the Danish Medicines Agency if synchronisation is used.

f.title: Parallel importers: forward unreported enquiries to the DKMA on request and periodically
f.statement: The holder of a parallel import MA is not covered by §§ 8 and 9 but shall forward to the Danish Medicines Agency all enquiries received under § 4, stk. 6 that are not reported under § 6 or § 7. Forwarding shall take place as soon as the Agency requests it, and at least every six months for the first 2 years after actual marketing starts, then once a year for the following two years and every three years thereafter.
